mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_pw, mem_cd, nickname, profile_file_id, gen_cd, status_cd, use_yn, pw_expire_dt, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(user_nm,'HEX'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS user_nm, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(phone,'HEX'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS phone, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(email,'HEX'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS email, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(birth,'HEX'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS birth, CASE WHEN pw_expire_dt IS NOT NULL AND pw_expire_dt < NOW() THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS pw_expired, CASE WHEN pw_expire_dt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(0, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pw_expire_dt - NOW())) / 86400)::int) END AS pw_days_left, CASE WHEN status_cd = 'STATUS02' AND is_account_non_locked_ti IS NOT NULL AND is_account_non_locked_ti + ((SELECT fail_cnt_denied_ti FROM t_config LIMIT 1) || ' minutes')::interval > NOW() THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS lock_active, fail_cnt, token_ver, (SELECT fail_cnt_limit FROM t_config LIMIT 1) AS fail_cnt_limit, (SELECT fail_cnt_denied_ti FROM t_config LIMIT 1) AS fail_cnt_denied_ti, CASE WHEN status_cd = 'STATUS02' AND is_account_non_locked_ti IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(1, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (is_account_non_locked_ti + ((SELECT fail_cnt_denied_ti FROM t_config LIMIT 1) || ' minutes')::interval - NOW())) / 60)::int) ELSE NULL END AS lock_remain_min FROM t_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND nickname = #{nickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND nickname = #{nickname} AND user_id <> #{userId}
UPDATE t_user SET token_ver = token_ver + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} RETURNING token_ver

SELECT user_id AS db_key, user_id, mem_cd, nickname, gen_cd, status_cd, use_yn, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(user_nm,'HEX'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS user_nm, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(phone,'HEX'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS phone, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(email,'HEX'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS email, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(birth,'HEX'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS birth FROM t_user WHERE user_id = #{dbKey} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user ( user_id, user_pw, mem_cd, user_nm, nickname, phone, email, gen_cd, birth, status_cd, use_yn, is_account_non_expired, is_account_non_locked, is_credentials_non_expired, is_enabled, fail_cnt, last_upd_dt, pw_expire_dt, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{memCd}, ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{userNm},'UTF8'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), #{nickname}, ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{phone},'UTF8'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{email},'UTF8'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), #{genCd}, ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{birth},'UTF8'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{statusCd}, ''), 'STATUS01'), 'Y', true, true, true, true, 0, NOW(), NOW() + (COALESCE((SELECT pw_expire_cnt FROM t_config LIMIT 1), 90) * INTERVAL '1 day'), #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET mem_cd = #{memCd}, gen_cd = #{genCd}, status_cd = #{statusCd}, user_nm = ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{userNm},'UTF8'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), phone = ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{phone},'UTF8'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), email = ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{email},'UTF8'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), birth = ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{birth},'UTF8'),#{encKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE user_id = #{dbKey}
UPDATE t_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE user_id = #{dbKey}
UPDATE t_user SET profile_file_id = #{profileFileId}::integer, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE user_id = #{dbKey}
UPDATE t_user SET last_login_dt = NOW(), last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, fail_cnt = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE t_user SET fail_cnt = fail_cnt + 1, status_cd = CASE WHEN fail_cnt + 1 >= (SELECT fail_cnt_limit FROM t_config LIMIT 1) THEN 'STATUS02' ELSE status_cd END, is_account_non_locked_ti = CASE WHEN fail_cnt + 1 >= (SELECT fail_cnt_limit FROM t_config LIMIT 1) THEN NOW() ELSE is_account_non_locked_ti END WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_user SET status_cd = 'STATUS01', fail_cnt = 0, is_account_non_locked_ti = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_user SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE user_id = #{dbKey}
mapper.select: SELECT authgrp_id FROM t_auth_user WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_user (user_id, authgrp_id, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{authgrpId}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
